About us

Your vehicle deserves expert care.

Strive Automotive is a Pretoria-based mobile mechanic team. We provide minor and major car service, repairs and maintenance on your driveway, at your workplace or at the roadside, with the right tools for the right job.

  • Skilled, hands-on technicians
  • Specialist tooling for VW, Audi and BMW engines
  • Honest fault finding before any repair

Our expertise

Precision engine work.

Timing chains, camshafts and cylinder heads demand exact tooling. We use manufacturer-style timing and locking tools so your engine is set up exactly as it should be.

  • Timing chain & VANOS work
  • Cylinder head and camshaft repairs
  • Full engine overhauls and rebuilds

FAQ

Common questions.

Do you come to my location?

Yes. Our slogan is service at your doorstep, so we work where your vehicle is.

Which vehicles do you service?

Petrol and diesel cars and light vehicles, including VW, Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Toyota, Ford and Land Rover.

Are you available after hours?

We offer a 24/7 breakdown service nationwide. Appointments are recommended for scheduled work.

How much is a diagnostic?

Diagnostics and fault finding start from R350.
